events.title: The Shield-Menders
events.description: At a shield repair queue, a huge patched shield props up the town gate.

choices.text: Stand watch by the giant shield (+2 scraps)
Trade a spare shield rivet (spend 1 scrap; gain 17 gold)
Leave without exchanging anything

events.title: Scarlet Thread Cart
events.description: The seamstress finds a wagon knotted with red-thread pennants and giant needles.

choices.text: Sew the red pennant (spend 1 scrap; gain 18 gold)
Buy a red-thread bundle (spend 12 gold; gain 2 scraps)
Leave without exchanging anything

events.title: The Clockwork Wagon
events.description: A clockwork trader's wagon ticks under a load of crooked buttons and gears.

choices.text: Gather the fallen gears (+1 scrap)
Repair the wagon ratchet (spend 2 scraps; gain 28 gold)
Leave without exchanging anything

events.title: Moth Vigil
events.description: A warm patchwork lantern gathers moths beside a candlelit cloth shrine.

choices.text: Guide the moths by lantern light (+2 scraps)
Buy lantern wax (spend 12 gold; gain 2 scraps)
Leave without exchanging anything

events.title: The Needle Fair
events.description: A caped duelist holds a friendly fencing fair with a long thin needle rapier.

choices.text: Win the friendly fencing purse (+20 gold)
Buy two red ribbon bundles (spend 10 gold; gain 2 scraps)
Leave without exchanging anything

events.title: The Crow's Threshing
events.description: A black crow perches on a burlap-headed straw doll beside an overgrown granary.

choices.text: Gather loose straw ties (+2 scraps)
Trade a bundle of crow feathers (spend 1 scrap; gain 19 gold)
Leave the roost untouched

events.title: The Knitted Ford
events.description: A narrow crossing is webbed with wool bolas and two bent knitting-needle posts.

choices.text: Retrieve a spool tangled in the ford (+1 scrap)
Buy fresh coloured wool (spend 14 gold; gain 2 scraps)
Cross without disturbing the knitting

events.title: The Giant Button Press
events.description: A rattling bronze press stamps brass buttons as a towering button-bodied golem waits.

choices.text: Feed the press two scrap bundles (spend 2 scraps; gain 31 gold)
Collect fallen button shanks (+1 scrap)
Leave the button press

events.title: The Evening Beacon
events.description: Moths ring a dim lantern pole while travellers queue to relight their stitched lamps.

choices.text: Trim the beacon wick (spend 1 scrap; gain 16 gold)
Buy two wax spools (spend 10 gold; gain 2 scraps)
Let the lantern burn

events.title: The Scarlet Fencing Fair
events.description: A feather-hatted puppet duelist invites the party to a needle-rapier bout.

choices.text: Win the fencing purse (+22 gold)
Buy fresh fencing ribbons (spend 13 gold; gain 2 scraps)
Bow and leave the fair

events.title: The Moonshield Watch
events.description: A button-eyed sentry stands beneath a bone-cream moon with a shield patched from midnight-blue coats.

choices.text: Pay 14 gold to polish the moonshield (+2 scraps)
Trade a spare shield stitch (spend 1 scrap; gain 21 gold)
Lower the shield and move on

events.title: The Scarlet Midnight Loom
events.description: A wide-eyed doll weaver tends a giant red needle, its loose threads glowing beside a plum velvet loom.

choices.text: Retie the snapped needle thread (+2 scraps)
Sell two spare thread bundles (spend 2 scraps; gain 24 gold)
Leave the loom humming

events.title: The Midnight Gearhouse
events.description: A hunched scrap-pack automaton sorts blunderbuss springs beneath lantern-lit copper shutters.

choices.text: Collect fallen spring teeth (+1 scrap)
Tune the scrap gears (spend 2 scraps; gain 27 gold)
Leave the clockwork ticking

events.title: The Blackcrow Post
events.description: A straw-stuffed watchman and its crow perch at a dusk-lit letterpost wrapped in worn denim.

choices.text: Follow the crow to a lost purse (+13 gold)
Buy twine to bind the loose straw (spend 13 gold; gain 2 scraps)
Let the crow keep watch

events.title: The Knitted Bolas Bridge
events.description: Knitting-needle arches stretch across a misty ford, hung with teal yarn bolas and mossy wool.

choices.text: Reel in the drifting bolas (+2 scraps)
Trade a knitting-needle spool (spend 1 scrap; gain 18 gold)
Cross without tangling the bridge

events.title: The Button-Bell Foundry
events.description: A huge round button golem braces a brass mould beneath dark-ink bells and candlelight.

choices.text: Steady the giant button mould (+17 gold)
Buy brass-thread spools (spend 19 gold; gain 3 scraps)
Leave the foundry ringing

events.title: The Buckle Checkpoint
events.description: A shield-wide patchwork watchtower guards the threadbare road while brass buckles rattle in the wind.

choices.text: Brace the caravan for a 16-gold watchman's wage
Trade two spare buckle scraps for 27 gold
Lower the shield and continue

events.title: The Crimson Mending Queue
events.description: A long row of button-eyed dolls waits beneath a giant red needle for a fresh hem.

choices.text: Sew the queue's frayed hems for two scraps
Spend 16 gold on three moonlit thread scraps
Fold the needle away and leave

events.title: The Clockwork Sideshow
events.description: A hunched goggle-maker's blunderbuss gears turn a little mechanical puppet stage.

choices.text: Repair the clockwork cog for a 20-gold fee
Pay 12 gold for two spring-cap scraps
Let the puppet stage go quiet

events.title: The Crow-Lantern Post
events.description: A black crow guards a lantern-lit granary where loose straw spills from stitched sacks.

choices.text: Gather one bundle of loose straw scraps
Trade two straw scraps for 23 gold
Leave the crow on its post

events.title: The Wool Signal Station
events.description: Knitting-needle signal masts span a misty ridge, hung with moss-green yarn bolas.

choices.text: Reel in two scraps of loose signal wool
Trade two bolas-knot scraps for 24 gold
Cross beneath the silent wool signals

events.title: The Rivet Bridge
events.description: A giant button-bodied porter holds a brass-riveted bridge steady in the dusk.

choices.text: Hold the bridge for an 18-gold porter's wage
Spend 17 gold on three brass-thread scraps
Let the bridge settle and go

events.title: The Mothglass Chapel
events.description: A round saffron-robed doll tends an amber lantern under stained button-glass; moths circle a cracked wick.

choices.text: Relight the saffron wick (spend 1 scrap; earn 22 gold)
Gather the fallen lantern wax (+1 scrap)
Leave the chapel's moths undisturbed

events.title: The Velvet Rapier Stage
events.description: A caped puppet challenges the Duelist to match his crimson ribbon against a blunted needle rapier.

choices.text: Win the velvet purse in a ribbon duel (+14 gold)
Buy fencing silk (spend 13 gold; gain 2 scraps)
Leave the puppet to bow alone

events.title: The Brass-Moth Clinic
events.description: A bent-wing clockwork moth ticks on a gear-backed stool beneath a warm mustard lamp.

choices.text: Repair the moth's wing (spend 2 scraps; earn 27 gold)
Gather discarded clock springs (+1 scrap)
Leave the brass moth resting

events.title: The Pumpkin-Seam Census
events.description: A plump burlap registrar counts pumpkin buttons while the Scarecrow's crow perches on a stitched ledger.

choices.text: Register the harvest (spend 1 scrap; earn 18 gold)
Gather loose hay offcuts (+2 scraps)
Leave the census table

events.title: The Tangled Willow
events.description: Knitting-needle branches cradle teal yarn above a lantern-lit river; the Ranger's bolas can reel it down.

choices.text: Retrieve the fallen wool cache (+10 gold)
Buy moss-green bolas cord (spend 17 gold; gain 3 scraps)
Leave the willow undisturbed

events.title: The Brass Keyhole
events.description: A huge moss-green door opens only when giant button fists press its rusted rivets.

choices.text: Push the rivet door (spend 2 scraps; earn 29 gold)
Gather loose button shanks (+1 scrap)
Leave the door closed
